structured_output.summary: The Head is 31, files single and has no qualifying children, so the only refundable credit they can claim is the EITC for a worker with no qualifying child. Earned income is the $5,923 of gross wages. AGI is $4,843: wages plus $1,920 of farm rent, less the capital loss limited to $3,000. Disqualified investment income is $1,920, under the $12,200 limit. The larger of AGI and earned income is below the $10,860 phaseout threshold, so the credit is the full phase-in amount: 7.65% × $5,923 ≈ $453.11. The engine's $453.096 uses an effective rate of $664/$8,680 (7.6498%), which differs from the statute by about a cent; the IRS EIC Table gives $453. The 0 cluster wrongly treats the ESI premiums as pre-tax pay reductions or adds nontaxable assistance to AGI. Neither reading fits the stated facts.
